title: Integrating Tessl with Gemini CLI
description:
Ready to connect Tessl with your favorite AI coding agent? 🚀

In this short tutorial, we show you how to quickly integrate Tessl with the Gemini CLI. After initializing Tessl in your project, it only takes one command to get everything connected. 

Watch as we run the tessl setup agent command and let Tessl automatically configure the MCP integration. Once complete, Gemini CLI is ready to use, instantly picking up the Tessl MCP server. Your next step is to start using the Spec Registry or the Tessl framework to guide your development.
